subject: QBR KPI alignment and metric deconfliction (Nov)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: QBR KPI alignment and metric deconfliction (Nov)

Team —

I pulled the monthly KPI dashboards this morning and flagged a few places where the QBR narrative will diverge unless we reconcile numbers and owners: latency (p50/p95 split), cost-per-inference delta across quantization profiles, uptime blips (last 30 days), and Nebula usage reconciliation for embeddings throughput.

Quick asks:
- Can each of you confirm an owner for the four areas above by EOD today?
- Laura: can you validate the uptime incident list and supply an updated mitigation plan?
- Markus: please sanity-check the cost slides — I think the GPU-util baseline is off for Dedicated.
- Irene: can you take the lead on the latency segmentation (p50/p90/p95) and add a short note on model-variant routing impact.

I've attached the working KPI pack (Nov_kpi_pack_v2.pdf) and added the Drive link below. If we don't resolve ownership before Wednesday's ops rehearsal, the QBR deck will show a mixed set of assumptions — which will confuse the execs.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/metrics/Nov-2026-kpi-pack
Attachment: Nov_kpi_pack_v2.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB)

Thanks —
Karthik
Director, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR KPI alignment and metric deconfliction (Nov)

Thanks, Karthik — good catch.

A few clarifications from my side:
- Latency: happy to own segmentation. Proposal: split by model-family (redwood-v2 vs community-v1) and by request type (short prompt vs long prompt) to better explain the p95 tail. I'll add a one-slide appendix with the histogram and a note on KV cache hit-rate impact.
- Cost: I agree with Markus that the Dedicated baseline looks inflated. Markus, can you confirm whether the autoscale cost in the dashboard includes the new burst window?
- Uptime: Laura should be primary owner here, but we should loop in Nebula on apparent spike on Nov 10 — their usage pattern shows a correlated rise in embedding throughput.

Quote: "If we don't resolve ownership before Wednesday's ops rehearsal..." — I'm on the rehearsal and can walk through the latency appendix if needed.

Irene
Sr. Engineering Manager, Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@nebulaanalytics.com>
Cc: Nebula Ops <nebula-ops@nebulaanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR KPI alignment and metric deconfliction (Nov)

Adding Rajesh from Nebula so they can confirm their ingestion/throughput numbers.

Short update from uptime side:
- I've validated the two incidents on Nov 10 and Nov 22. Root cause for Nov 10 is a warm-start KV-cache miss spike after the model swap; Nov 22 was a transient infra-network blip during a rolling upgrade.
- Proposed mitigation (attached): a short canary window for model swaps (15 minutes, low-traffic route) and an automated KV-cache prewarm task.
- I'll own the uptime slide and will include a one-slide timeline + escalation path.

Attachment: uptime-fix-plan.docx (DOCX, 68KB)

Laura Bennett
Head of Reliability
Redwood Inference

Thanks all for the heads up and the data. Quick confirmation from our side:
- Nov 10 spike was triggered by a large batch re-ingest for a new customer pipeline; we did see a temporary 2x rise in embedding throughput between 09:05–09:20 PST.
- Our recorded usage numbers for Nov match what Karthik pulled in the KPI pack; I'll attach a CSV export to the follow-up (we keep it internal for now).

Would appreciate a 30-minute sync with Laura and Karthik tomorrow to walk the canary plan and agree on an ops contact for immediate escalation. 

Best —
Rajesh Kumar
Head of Platform, Nebula Analytics
rajesh@nebulaanalytics.com
